title: CNMH Bridge
description: Bridges this Foundry world to the CNMH app over WebSocket. Connects to the Cloudflare session relay and syncs combat, character state, and token movement.

recommends.reason: Plays the app's battle-FX catalog (spell/strike animations via JB2A assets); without it the bridge disables animations with a single warning.
3D dice for app-requested rolls, including per-character signature dice sets; without it rolls resolve in chat only.
